# hvrg_alert_rule (Resource)

The alert_rule records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) display name
- `source_id` (String) the source whose telemetry the rule reads
- `threshold` (Number) the value compared against

### Optional

- `action` (String) Tengo program run when the rule flips
- `comparison` (String) gt, gte, lt, lte or eq
- `enabled` (Boolean) false stops the evaluation without removing the rule
- `interval_seconds` (Number) seconds between evaluations, at least 10
- `owner_id` (String) owning organization
- `query` (Dynamic) the query the evaluator runs, {language: sql or tengo, code}
- `severity` (String) info, warning or critical
